decks.notes: This deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, aiming to overwhelm the opponent with a cascade of powerful spells. Utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck is able to constantly put pressure on the opponent by putting creatures into play for free. It also includes a mix of interaction with cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Prismari Command to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck's mana base is carefully crafted to support its aggressive gameplay while also providing flexibility in casting its spells.

The main concept of this Dredge combo deck is to utilize graveyard-based mechanics to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam, while also using cards like Cathartic Reunion and Thrilling Discovery to draw through the deck and trigger abilities. The key focus is on cycling through the deck quickly to bring back multiple creatures from the graveyard at once, overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of creatures. Additionally, cards like Creeping Chill provide additional damage and life gain for extra value.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage provided by planeswalkers like Teferi. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gradually building up resources and threats. Cards like Cryptic Command and Archmage's Charm offer versatility, while cards like Supreme Verdict and Solitude provide board control. The deck also utilizes cards like Chalice of the Void and Spreading Seas to disrupt the opponent's mana base and game plan. Ultimately, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through efficient control elements.

The main goal of this deck is to quickly ramp up with cards like Azusa, Arboreal Grazer, and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to cast Primeval Titan and search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and lands that can be used to activate it multiple times in a turn. This allows the player to deal large amounts of damage to their opponent by repeatedly triggering Valakut's ability. The deck also includes utility lands like Urza's Saga and Karn, the Great Creator to help tutor for key artifacts and further accelerate the combo.

This deck focuses on using its control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating value through card advantage and graveyard recursion. By efficiently removing threats, disrupting the opponent's hand, and leveraging card selection, it aims to outvalue the opponent and grind them out of resources. Lurrus of the Dream-Den acts as a valuable companion, providing additional recursion for low-cost threats. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through a combination of removal, disruption, and card advantage to secure a victory.

This deck aims to win quickly by milling key combo pieces and then utilizing graveyard recursion to bring back powerful creatures like Vengevine and Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck focuses on manipulating the graveyard to set up explosive plays while also utilizing mana rocks like Pentad Prism and Talisman of Hierarchy to ramp into its key combo pieces. The inclusion of Sword of the Meek and Goblin Charbelcher provides additional win conditions and backup plans in case the primary combo is disrupted. The deck is designed to be fast and efficient in its execution, overwhelming opponents with its graveyard-based combos.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping mana with lands and creatures, while utilizing Amulet of Vigor to untap lands for explosive plays. The goal is to assemble the Amulet Titan combo of Primeval Titan and lands like Vesuva and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal lethal damage swiftly. The deck also includes utility lands like Urza's Saga and Tolaria West for additional value. By efficiently tutoring for key pieces and ramping quickly, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful combo plays and finish the game before they can respond.

This deck focuses on using low-cost threats and disruption spells to control the board and pressure the opponent quickly. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Inquisition of Kozilek, and Death's Shadow, along with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong offense. Additionally, the inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value by recurring smaller creatures and spells from the graveyard. The deck's versatility and aggressive nature make it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on maintaining control of the game by utilizing counterspells, removal spells, and board wipes to keep the opponent's threats in check. It also aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Spreading Seas while generating card advantage with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Archmage's Charm. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion adds additional synergies and flexibility to the deck. Overall, the key strategy is to control the game, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and eventually win through incremental advantage and powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Cascade mechanic to cast powerful spells for free, creating a fast-paced aggressive strategy. By combining both efficient creatures and versatile spells like Fury and Prismari Command, the deck aims to maintain board control while overwhelming the opponent with threats. The addition of Force of Negation provides protection against disruptive spells, allowing the deck to continue its aggressive game plan. The mana base is built to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory through aggressive Cascade plays.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Aggro strategy with Death's Shadow as a key threat, supplemented by disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch to control the game. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure and generate card advantage. Lurrus of the Dream-Den serves as a companion to provide additional value and recursion. Overall, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total while disrupting their game plan to secure a victory.

This UW Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through counterspells and removal spells while utilizing Teferi to draw cards and control the board. The deck aims to stall the game until it can establish powerful threats like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and finish off the opponent with powerful finishers like Hall of Storm Giants. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Spreading Seas and Chalice of the Void to disrupt the opponent's mana base and game plan. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent to secure victory.
